decision.observation: The goose stands against the gate's right post facing north. A grass slope rises up-right between the post and the dark hedge, toward where a rope-and-bell was sighted in early wide views.
decision.hypothesis: The slope northeast of the right post may lead up toward the rope-and-bell that summons the groundskeeper to open the gate.
decision.memory: Latch grabs (all variants) have failed to visibly open the gate; the bell route remains untested up close.
